evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - Farama-Foundation/Gymnasium-Robotics: A collection of robotics simulation environments for reinforcement learning · GitHub
evidence.statement: Official maintained Gymnasium-Robotics release explicitly lists Adroit Arm environments and a state/action stepping interface. Scope is the simulator; legacy D4RL demonstrations are not newly collected data.
